notes.title: Update to 1.0.2
notes.content:
Yo! Since the game is hitting consoles this year, I took the opportunity to dive back into the code base and fix up some things. Here's the changelog:

[list]
[*] The boss cutscene is now skipped on respawn, so you can try again quicker
[*] Added animated background elements to all levels
[*] Added a new animation when Shino-kun jumps out of a slide at high speed, because why not
[*] Made menu navigation a bit more consistent
[*] Fixed a bug where Shino-kun would be stuck in his falling animation after hitting the ceiling after a kick (yeah, it's specific)
[*] Fixed a bug where the dive kick wouldn't come out if triggered on the same frame as landing from a jump (yeah, speedrunners found this one)
[*] Added particles when wading through deep snow
[*] Maybe something else I forgot, or as companies call it: "various fixes and improvements"
[/list]

In case any of these changes breaks something else, let me know in the comments or hop into [url=https://discord.gg/qE2RKGAJxq]my Discord[/url] and tell me there. Thanks for the support, and a kickass 2024 to all of you!

-Ando

notes.title: I Have a Developer Page!
notes.content:
Yo, just a quick note that I have now set up a [url=https://store.steampowered.com/developer/ohsat]developer page[/url] here on Steam! It's an easy way to check out all the games I have on here, and you can even follow me to get notified whenever I release something new!

Which might be kinda soon...

So if you want to get notified, [url=https://store.steampowered.com/developer/ohsat]check it out[/url] and hit that follow button. If you [i]don't[/i] want to get notified then don't do that, I guess.

notes.title: Version 1.0.1: CRT Settings
notes.content: Here's a little update for the retro fans! In version 1.0.1 you can now adjust various parameters of the CRT effect, such as brightness and curvature. Wanna know what it's like playing Chibi Ninja Shino-kun on a broken CRT? Put away that hammer and get the update!

notes.title: How's the Game?
notes.content:
Hey everyone! The game's been out for three weeks now, so I thought I'd check in and ask how you're all enjoying it.

I actually meant to do this earlier, but I've been sick in bed for over two weeks now, got a cold + covid ultra combo. So...yeah.

So anyway, are you enjoying Chibi Ninja Shino-kun? Is there anything that you particularly enjoy, or maybe something that annoys you a bit? I've heard rumblings of some people having trouble getting the walljump down. What about you?

In case you didn't know: I'm a solo dev, so I'm open to feedback. It of course also means that I can't always respond to that feedback, as I really have to be careful about how I divide up my time and energy. Trying to get a solo indiedev business up and running is madness, let me tell you. But I do want to at least make a sincere effort, so if you have any kind of feedback, let me know in the comments!

Oh, and finally: Since I am a solo dev, I'm very dependent on your support. So if you enjoyed the game: [b]Please leave a Steam review.[/b] You don't have to overthink it. Just make it a joke one, if you want. It doesn't really matter, any review is better than no review.

Well, except for maybe a negative review.

Thanks for reading, and be excellent to each other!
-Ando
